sections.title: Your AI portfolio project

blocks.title: Not from your PDFs
blocks.text: No guide of yours covers this, so this page was written for the site, as of October 2026. Tools and versions change quickly: check the official documentation before relying on details.

blocks: One deployed project turns everything in this stage into interview stories. Add it to a project you already have, rather than starting from nothing.

rows: Chat over your own guides, with citations
Keep the guides private if you don't own them
Support assistant for an existing project
blocks.caption: My pick: add an assistant to a project you already have. It also deepens your project deep dive.

rows: Spring AI, chat with streaming, React UI
Streams answers; has timeouts and limits
Evaluation set of 30+ questions; one tool with permissions
You have a score and improved it
Deploy on AWS, with tracing, cost tracking and a demo
Public demo, or a recording; README with numbers

blocks.title: Fill in with your real measured numbers
Keep it honest
blocks.text: This is project experience, so label it that way. Interviewers will ask how you evaluated it and what failed.

blocks.title: Key points
blocks.text:
- Extend a real project.
- Evaluation and cost numbers set you apart.
- Deploy it, and be ready to demo it.

items.question: What will interviewers ask about this project?
items.answer: Why RAG, the chunking choice, how you measured quality, failure cases, cost, and how you handled security and prompt injection.
